**A tiny pixel Clawd that lives on your desktop and opens Claude or Claude Code in one move.**
First public release for macOS, Windows and Linux. Native Rust, one small binary, no Electron.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bogdanminko/claude-companion/main/docs/fiesta.gif" width="200"> <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bogdanminko/claude-companion/main/docs/clones.gif" width="200">

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon + Intel) | `ClaudeCompanion-macOS.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `ClaudeCompanion-Setup.exe` (installer, no admin) or `ClaudeCompanion-portable.exe` |
| Linux x86_64 (Debian, Ubuntu…) | `claude-companion_amd64.deb` |
| Linux x86_64 (any distro) | `claude-companion-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

Or let Claude install it. Paste this into Claude Code:

```bash
claude "Install Claude Companion: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bogdanminko/claude-companion/main/skills/install/SKILL.md"
```

## What's inside

- **Launcher capsule**: hover Pixel and pick **Claude** (desktop app) or **Claude Code** (new session). Without Claude Desktop it opens claude.ai or the `claude` CLI in a terminal.
- **Double Alt** (double **Option** on a Mac) from any app shows the capsule.
- **Voice**: Claude voice input on Caps Lock; Pixel flaps its arms while you talk.
- **Alive**: blinks, wanders, jumps, waves, glitches, plays guitar in a sombrero, falls asleep when ignored. Once in a while it vanishes in smoke and splits into five little clones 🥷
- Floats above all windows; drag it anywhere and it remembers the spot.
- Pixel-style right-click menu plus a tray / menu bar icon.
- Starts at login (toggle in the menu) and restarts itself after a crash.
- About 1–2 MB, near-zero CPU when idle.

## First launch

The builds aren't signed with paid certificates yet:

- **macOS**: "Apple could not verify…" → System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. Then grant **Accessibility** (needed for double Option and the Caps Lock voice key).
- **Windows**: SmartScreen → **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Linux**: needs X11 or XWayland and a compositor for transparency. On GNOME the tray icon needs the AppIndicator extension.

## Known limitations

- On Wayland, double Alt and Caps Lock only see key presses in X11/XWayland apps.
- No auto-update yet: download the new version, or ask Claude to run the install line again.
- No Windows ARM or Linux arm64 builds; build from source for those.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/bogdanminko/claude-companion/issues) and attach the log:
macOS `/tmp/claude-companion.err.log`, Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-companion\companion.log`, Linux `~/.cache/claude-companion/companion.log`.

> Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Anthropic. Clawd is the Claude Code mascot from the CLI banner.
